# EPUB fixtures

Synthetic EPUBs are generated by `tests/test_convert.py` so the edge-case matrix is reproducible without redistributing book text.

The checked-in real corpus was retrieved on 2026-08-22 from Project Gutenberg public-domain EPUB editions:

- `real/gutenberg-classic.epub` — [Pride and Prejudice, ebook 1342](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342.epub.images).
- `real/footnotes-tables.epub` — [Great Expectations, ebook 1400](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1400.epub.images), chosen for its long-form structural markup.
- `real/no-nav.epub` — [Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, ebook 11](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.epub.noimages), an EPUB 2/NCX-era fixture for navigation fallback coverage.
